At AestheticEye in Cincinnati, OH, our board-certified oculoplastic surgeons, Dr. Ginger Henson and Dr. Jonathan Pargament, specialize in both traditional and endoscopic brow lifts. Why Consider a Forehead & Brow Lift?

As we age, the skin on our forehead and brows can begin to sag, leading to a tired or angry appearance. A forehead and brow lift can effectively address these concerns by lifting and tightening the skin and underlying tissues. Here are some benefits of the procedure:

Rejuvenated Appearance

Lifts sagging brows and smooths forehead wrinkles, giving you a more youthful look.

Improved Facial Harmony

Enhances the overall balance of your facial features.

Boosted Self-Confidence

A refreshed appearance can significantly boost your self-esteem.

Traditional Brow Lift vs. Endoscopic Brow Lift

Traditional Brow Lift

A traditional brow lift involves making an incision along the hairline to lift and reposition the skin and underlying tissues. This method is particularly effective for individuals with significant sagging and deeper wrinkles.

Endoscopic Brow Lift in Cincinnati, OH

An endoscopic brow lift is a minimally invasive technique that uses small incisions and an endoscope (a tiny camera) to lift the brow. This method results in less scarring and a quicker recovery time while still providing excellent results.

View More Before & After Results

The Forehead & Brow Lift Procedure

At AestheticEye, our surgeons use advanced techniques to ensure optimal outcomes for both traditional and endoscopic brow lifts. The procedure involves:

  • Making incisions along the hairline or within the scalp.
  • Lifting and repositioning the underlying tissues and skin.
  • Removing excess skin and smoothing out wrinkles.
  • Closing the incisions with sutures or staples.

The choice between a traditional and endoscopic brow lift will depend on your specific needs and aesthetic goals, which will be thoroughly discussed during your consultation.

What to Expect in Recovery and Results

Recovery from a forehead and brow lift varies depending on the technique used. Generally, patients can expect:

Mild Swelling and Bruising

These symptoms typically subside within one to two weeks.

Minimal Discomfort

Pain is usually minimal and can be managed with prescribed medications.

Return to Normal Activities

Most patients return to their regular routines within 10-14 days.

The final results will become more apparent as swelling decreases, revealing a smoother, more youthful forehead and elevated brows.

Frequently Asked Questions | Forehead & Brow Lift Surgery

What Issues Can a Forehead & Brow Lift Address?

A forehead and brow lift can correct sagging brows, deep forehead wrinkles, and frown lines between the eyebrows, providing a more youthful and refreshed appearance.

Am I a Good Candidate for an Endoscopic Brow Lift?

Ideal candidates for an endoscopic brow lift are individuals with mild to moderate brow sagging who are looking for a minimally invasive option with quicker recovery times.

How Long Will the Results Last?

The results of a forehead and brow lift can last for many years, though the natural aging process will continue. Maintaining a healthy lifestyle and skincare routine can help prolong the results.

Are There Risks Associated with Brow Lift Surgery?

As with any surgical procedure, there are potential risks, including infection, scarring, and complications related to anesthesia. These risks are minimized when the surgery is performed by experienced oculoplastic surgeons like Dr. Henson and Dr. Pargament at AestheticEye.

What is the Difference Between a Traditional and Endoscopic Brow Lift?

A traditional brow lift involves a longer incision along the hairline and is ideal for significant sagging, while an endoscopic brow lift uses smaller incisions and a camera for a less invasive approach and quicker recovery.

How Soon Will I See Results After the Surgery?

Initial results can be seen as swelling and bruising subside, typically within two weeks. Full results, showcasing a smoother and more elevated brow area, will be visible in a few months.
